text: In two thousand four, a young man came home to Sydney. And nobody was waiting.
So he made a cardboard sign: "Free Hugs."
And stood in a busy city mall.
For days, people just walked past.
Then one stranger stopped. And hugged him.
Ten thousand people signed a petition to bring the hugs back.
Sometimes all we need is someone who stops.
That's why we made Feeloy. Jenny always has time for you.
